name: ozone-web-extension
description: Ozone — Chia browser extension wallet (Goby-compatible, coinset.org sync)

scripts.wasm:build: cd ../vendor/sage && wasm-pack build crates/sage-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../ozone-web-extension/packages/wallet-wasm --features coinset-sync,wasm
scripts.build: pnpm wasm:build && pnpm wasm:opt && pnpm --filter @ozone/extension build
